function.description: Schedule a durable task to run later or on a recurring cycle (not bound to this turn).
function.name: cronjob_schedule

parameters.description: Schedule a durable task. NOT bound to this turn — it runs later/on a cycle.

deliver.description: Optional out-of-band delivery sink for the result: 'telegram' or 'email' (to the owner), or 'twitter' — a PUBLIC post on the agent's X account, when the X pack is enabled. It copies the run's last send_message; without one it sends nothing. Omit for no copy.

deliver_target.description: Optional explicit recipient; ignored unless the operator enabled CRON_DELIVERY_ALLOW_EXPLICIT_TARGET.

exact_time.description: Keep this exact minute. True only when the owner named the minute or the work must start then (a market open, a mint). Otherwise a job that overlaps another moves to the nearest free minute, and the result names the move.

expect.description: What a run of this job must do, checked by code from the run's own act rows: {'effect': 'social', 'min': 1}, or {'idle_ok': true} when a run with no act is fine. The result is the run's verified field. Unset: no check.

kb_holdout_pct.description: OWNER TURN ONLY: the percent of this job's runs (0-100) that skip knowledge-base auto-injection, to measure its value. 0 or absent: none.

max_duration_seconds.description: Hard cap per run (60-1800s; default 600). A money job that quotes, swaps and reports needs ~15-25 min.

pause_windows.description: Per-job pause windows: [[start, end], ...] as epoch seconds or ISO-8601 UTC. A tick inside a window is a $0 skip.

precheck.description: For a WATCH job (monitor/scout/exit/watcher): a $0 check that runs BEFORE the model each tick — {'verb': <a read_verb verb>, 'params': {...}, 'alert': {'field', 'below'?, 'above'?}, 'move_pct': 5, 'field': 'price_usd', 'max_quiet_hours': 24}. When the read is clean, no alert fires and the field moved less than move_pct since the last model run, the tick is skipped at $0. Otherwise the run starts with the read attached. Use it on every price/pool watch.

read_verb.description: W9: make this a DETERMINISTIC read job — one allowlisted read verb, no LLM turn per tick: {'verb': 'defi_data.pool_metrics', 'params': {...the verb's params...}, 'deliver_on': 'alert'|'always'|'never'}. 'alert' (default) delivers only a result with an ALERT line or an error. Verbs: defi_data.pool_metrics, defi_data.price, defi_data.token_info, defi_data.wallet_holdings, defi_data.position_mark, defi_data.discovery_count (public on-chain reads only; a web page or any other source cannot be a read verb). A price/value watch adds 'alert': {'field': '<key of the verb result metadata>', 'below': n, 'above': n} — the verb compares, you never do; an unreadable value alerts.

rig.description: Optional named tool rig for this job's runs: 'money_rail', 'social', 'research', 'ops', or 'full' (everything this deploy grants). A narrow rig ships fewer tool schemas per step. A rig is a request, not a grant. Omit for this deploy's default.

schedule.description: When to run: '30m'/'2h'/'1d', 'every monday 09:00', 5-field cron '*/15 * * * *', an ISO timestamp (one-shot), or a fixed N-day cycle 'every 3d from 2026-10-26T18:00Z'. An ISO time with Z is UTC; every other clock time is the server clock.

script.description: A SCRIPT job — your own file runs on the schedule, no LLM turn per tick: {'path': 'jobs/collect.py', 'args': ['--x', '1'], 'timeout_s': 120, 'deliver_on': 'alert'|'always'|'never'}. The path is a .py or .sh file in the workspace; write and test it with run_code first. It runs in the code sandbox from the workspace root. Exit code 0 = done; any other exit code or a timeout = failed and alerts. A stdout line that starts with ALERT alerts on a clean run. Use it for repeated mechanical work (collect, count, check) that needs no judgment.

skills.description: Optional skill ids this job's runs must load (its doctrine, e.g. ['x-engagement']). Pinned skills load every run; without a pin the run picks from the skill index. They grant no tool. Up to 8.

target_token.description: For a job that BUYS one specific token: {'chain': ..., 'address': ...}. Every run's buys are then refused unless they name exactly this contract — the address lives in the job as data, never only in the task text. It only restricts; it grants nothing.

task.description: The task the scheduled agent should perform.

tier.description: Optional model tier for this work's runs — from the owner's chat only: 'heavy' for work that decides money (who is paid, how much, a winner) or is hard to undo; 'light' for bulk reads; 'default' = the normal model. <environment> names each tier's model. Requires 'why'.

tools.description: Optional exact tool ids for this job's runs, when no rig fits. They win over the rig. A money tool needs a rig or the owner's /job new.

wake_agent.description: If false, this tick runs without invoking the LLM (a $0 no-op tick). Default true = normal agent run.

why.description: One line: why this tier. Required with 'tier'; shown in /status.

write_verb.description: OWNER TURN ONLY: a deterministic WRITE job, no LLM turn per tick: {'verb': 'agent_nft.agent_nft_collection_reveal', 'params': {'chain': 'robinhood', 'max_ids': 10, 'dry_run': false}, 'deliver_on': 'alert'}. It spends gas (at most AGENT_NFT_REVEAL_MAX_GAS_USD per run) while CRON_WRITE_JOBS_ENABLED=true; without dry_run=false it only simulates.
